STATE OF TENNESSEE OFFICE OF URBAN AND FEDERAL AFFAIRS
SUITE 1312 
ANDREW JACKSON STATE OFFICE BUILDING NASHVILLE 37219
GARY S. SASSE DIRECTOR
615-741-2714
July 17, 1972
Mr. Douglas Hoff, Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation U.S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C.
Dear Mr. Hoff:
Thank you for the opportunity to review the Bureau's draft Environmental Impact Statement for implementation of Executive Order 11644, providing for the control of use of off-road vehicles on public lands. Enclosed are the comments of our Department of Conservation and our Came and Fish Commission.
I would appreciate receiving a copy of your final statement when it is prepared. Thank you very much.
Sincerely,

John Wellborn
Grant Review Coordinator
